lines.2: A constitutional monarchy occupying the eastern side of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe.
lines.3: To cut straight to the point, the scenery was absolutely gorgeous.
lines.6: 「It's so cold, roses won't bloom even when I strike a pose!」
lines.7: 「Ooooh, yeah, it's freezing out here. I knew it would be cold since it's way up at the top of the map, but...」
lines.13: 「Damn you and your obnoxiously happy relationship.」
lines.14: 「Come on, Yoppi. You've seen more than enough of the northern lights. We're going back.」
lines.16: 「You heard her. You two can head back without us.」
lines.17: 「I can't believe Yoppi, of all people, has lasted this long in the cold...」
lines.21: 「You've really grown into a dependable man, Leo... I'm happy for you, but a little sad too...」
lines.22: 「Want to try dating each other, Princess?」
lines.24: 「That's the first time I've ever been shot down in under a second.」
lines.27: 「Tch. You two really love rubbing it in, don't you? Calling each other by your first names and everything!」
lines.28: The other members of our group went back ahead of us.
lines.29: 「The northern lights are beautiful... I could watch them forever.」
lines.32: 「Being able to see them with you feels like a dream, Tsushima.」
lines.35: 「I've always had trouble trusting people. I'm afraid they'll betray me...」
lines.36: 「But you're so kind... Little by little, worrying about it has started to feel silly.」
lines.37: 「...Yeah. No matter what happens, I'll never betray you.」
lines.38: 「I'll prove it to you over and over, so you'd better be ready.」
lines.40: Yoshimi smiled like a flower coming into bloom.
lines.41: I vowed to spend the rest of my life with the girl who had said she loved me for who I was.
